scope: Read-only final019438C8 lineage cancellation/recovery seam only. No product edits, build, tests or hardware actions. Owner current cut HIL must not be interrupted.
sequence: delete.inc10 reports owned when auto_running or clock_held.
stream.c4304/4327/4339 Reset/Disconnect/Suspend callback increments host epoch and invokes np_usb_delete_cancel for owned delete/recovery.
delete.inc75 -> wire.h58 sets cancelled1; queued host work is canceled when notrunning. auto recovery has no queued wire request, but its shared flag is still set.
delete.inc47 shared write rejects cancelled before each HAL command, including automatic recovery writes.
A HAL write already entered still completes and undergoes physical retirement; the bus callback does not cancel its accepted SD write. A later required CP/journal write is refused.
core delete.h151-159 recovery may need CP0/CP1 repair then both journal clears, so cancellation between those writes returns IO with durable journal authority retained.

delete.inc118 sets auto_checked1 even on error, then port_error1. No same-boot reset/retry of auto_checked exists in the reviewed sources. New inspect can clear wire.cancelled but does not schedule automatic recovery again.
effect: Accepted durable-intent recovery can be prematurely stopped by host enumeration/reset while the device remains powered; it stays safely journal-recoverable on a later MCU boot, but the current boot does not automatically finish. This is not an abort of an active accepted HAL write.
fix_constraints: Separate automatic validated-journal recovery from cancellation of host request intent; keep physical ownership/error/card guards unchanged.

Do not use auto_running alone as durable recovery proof: queued op1/op2 also set it before invoking wire service. A simple cancelled&&!auto_running gate would suppress pre-intent host cancellation too.
Retain cancellation before durable intent, exact confirmed card/source binding and normal unknown host outcome after bus change; no mutation replay of arbitrary unconfirmed requests.
After physical I/O error or unretired ownership, preserve HOLD; do not blindly retry an unknown accepted write.
minimal_targeted_check: Actual automatic recovery with valid pending journal, inject Reset/Disconnect between required CP/journal writes; assert existing HAL command drains, remaining durable recovery completes independent of configured/host cancellation, and unconfirmed queued host delete still cancels without writes. No request for another hardware run from this reviewer.
limitations: Source causal proof only, not a claim that the current physical cut run encountered this timing.
